newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-TWO ENGLISH CLUBS REPORTEDLY BID FOR BAGGIO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TWO ENGLISH CLUBS REPORTEDLY BID FOR BAGGIO.

text.p: AC Milan have received two offers from English clubs for Italy midfielder Roberto Baggio, Milan vice-president Adriano Galliani was quoted as saying on Tuesday.

Galliani did not name the clubs and said the offers had neither been either accepted or rejected. He added Milan had received an offer from serie A side Bologna for Baggio, who has said he will quit Milan before the start of next season.
"We will leave the player to decide, even if the offers are very lucrative," Italian news agency ANSA quoted Galliani as saying.
A Milan spokeswoman said she could not confirm the report.
"All I can tell you is that for now Baggio remains a Milan player," she said.
Milan received a bid for Baggio from English premier league side Derby County earlier this month but negotiations between the two sides failed to produce an agreement.
Baggio has also been linked to Spain's Barcelona and Atletico Madrid as well as a number of top Italian sides.
